_about: Crafting recipes (D106). Each: id (never change it once used), name, category (for the list), inputs (items used up: [item, count]), tools (kept: each entry is a list of items, any one of which will do), outputs ([item, count]), and a line of flavour. 'heat' in tools means a fire: a lighter or matches. Add a recipe by adding an entry; the items come from items.json.
